gate_policy: Only selected ID, OOD-development and independent frozen-external sources may pass; every selected source must have verified access, license, task match, metric-compatible labels, highest-level provenance groups and required reject negatives.

sources.name: Crop Row Detection Lincoln Dataset v2.1
sources.notes: Best robot-view match: 2000 image-mask pairs, 50 condition classes and line coordinates. The repository exposes no dataset license; official split is organized by classes, while field/date/sequence/camera grouping is not supplied.

sources.name: CCRDNet dataset and video results
sources.notes: Direct central-row masks and 8 crop species are useful for OOD study, but all images were handheld-phone captures with unconstrained height/angle, not the contracted ground-robot camera. Every image was verified to contain a central row, so reject negatives are absent.

sources.name: Bonn Multi-Crop Row Navigation Dataset
sources.notes: The README documents five real crops, three simulated fields, varied camera tilt and position/orientation labels, but access requires emailing the author and the repository BSD license does not explicitly establish the separately supplied dataset license.

sources.name: Minimal maize plus CRBD subset
sources.notes: Downloaded and inspected on Day60. It mixes a CRBD subset and author-captured maize data without a per-file source/sequence manifest; it must not be randomly split or promoted to external evidence.
